title: Local smooth rigidity of Anosov diffeomorphisms in $\mathbb{T}^{3}$
summary: Given a $C^0$ conjugacy between two Anosov diffeomorphisms, the matching periodic data problem asks whether this conjugacy is smooth provided spectral data of the diffeomorphisms match at periodic points. We show that if the two $C^0$ conjugate diffeomorphisms on $\mathbb{T}^3$ are sufficiently close to a hyperbolic linear automorphism with a pair of complex conjugate eigenvalues, then the conjugacy must be smooth. In particular, we have that in a neighborhood of a hyperbolic toral automorphism, matching periodic data implies that the conjugacy is $C^{1+\text{Hölder}}$
